engine: V8.0 Historical Replay & Walk-Forward Backtest Engine

methodology.decision_timing: Features use data through prior session; weights execute next session close.
methodology.weighting: Equal base weight across eligible current portfolio names, then strategic exposure multipliers HOLD=1.0, WATCH=0.75, REDUCE=0.50, EXIT=0.0.

equal_weight_control.description: Same current portfolio names, same historical eligibility, same weekly rebalance timing and same trading friction, but without the strategic de-risking overlay.

equal_weight_75_25.label: 75% Equal Weight / 25% Cash
equal_weight_75_25.cost_model_note: Scaled from the already net-of-friction equal-weight control return stream; displayed trading-cost field is zero because no second cost layer is applied.

equal_weight_65_35.cost_model_note: Scaled from the already net-of-friction equal-weight control return stream; displayed trading-cost field is zero because no second cost layer is applied.

volatility_matched_equal_weight.cost_model_note: Scaled from the already net-of-friction equal-weight control return stream; displayed trading-cost field is zero because no second cost layer is applied.

exposure_attribution_verdict.exposure_proxy_note: Descriptive proxy only; drawdown is nonlinear and this ratio is not a causal decomposition.
exposure_attribution_verdict.methodology_note: Full-sample volatility/drawdown-matched cash allocations use contemporaneous strategy risk. They are hindsight-fit diagnostics, not independent out-of-sample benchmarks.

rolling_oos_exposure_attribution.methodology_note: Every exposure decision is estimated only from the prior 126 sessions and frozen for the next 21 sessions. No future return is used to set that block's benchmark exposure.
rolling_oos_exposure_attribution.cost_model_note: AURORA and the 100% equal-weight source return streams already contain their modeled trading friction. Rolling control returns are scaled from that net control stream, but no additional cost is charged for monthly cash/exposure changes. This is favorable to the benchmark and therefore conservative for AURORA.
rolling_oos_exposure_attribution.scope_note: This is out-of-sample exposure attribution for the reconstructable price/risk overlay on the current holdings universe. It does not remove survivorship/selection bias and is not statistical proof of full-system alpha.

validation_verdict.message: Strategic overlay materially reduces drawdown but sacrifices too much return versus the same-universe control. Thresholds should be recalibrated before relying on the overlay.

limitations: Historical news, catalyst and sector snapshots were not archived consistently and are intentionally excluded.

The universe is today's portfolio, creating survivorship and selection bias. The equal-weight control uses the same biased universe so overlay-vs-control is more informative than strategy-vs-SPY for isolating the risk overlay.
This validates the reconstructable strategic price/risk overlay, not the entire live AURORA decision stack.
Taxes are excluded. Trading friction is modeled using the explicit commission and slippage assumptions above.
No parameter optimization is performed inside the test window; sequential folds are fixed-rule out-of-sample replay.
interpretation: Use this result as evidence about the V7.9 strategic price/risk layer. Do not use it as proof that the full AURORA system is profitable until point-in-time fundamental/news data and broker execution are also validated.
